description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories, with 12 slices in total. The categories and their corresponding approximate percentages are: AI/NLP Research (24.3%, blue), Econ. & Fin. (18.4%, teal), Game&Anime (8.2%, dark orange), Law (8.2%, pink), History (6.7%, yellow), Med & Health (6.7%, green), Business (5.9%, red), Pet & Animal (5.5%, orange), Science (5.1%, light blue), Daily Life (7.1%, light teal), Geography (2.7%, dark green), and Math (1.2%, bright yellow). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected by lines to their corresponding categories, and does not have a legend. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
